Bash(node -e "const { GoogleGenerativeAI } = require\(''@google/generative-ai''\); require\(''dotenv''\).config\(\); console.log\(''Key:'', process.env.GEMINI_API_KEY?.substring\(0,10\)+''...''\); async function t\(\) { try { const g = new GoogleGenerativeAI\(process.env.GEMINI_API_KEY\); const m = g.getGenerativeModel\({ model: ''gemini-2.0-flash-exp'', generationConfig: { responseModalities: [''IMAGE'',''TEXT''] } }\); const r = await m.generateContent\(''Generate a simple pixel art ninja avatar''\); const parts = r.response.candidates?.[0]?.content?.parts || []; console.log\(''Parts:'', parts.length\); parts.forEach\(\(p,i\) => { if\(p.inlineData\) console.log\(''img'',i,p.inlineData.mimeType,p.inlineData.data?.length\); if\(p.text\) console.log\(''txt'',i,p.text.substring\(0,100\)\); }\); } catch\(e\) { console.error\(''ERR:'', e.message\); console.error\(''STATUS:'', e.status\); } } t\(\);")

Style: ''+s+''. Square, centered, dark background.''\); const parts = r.response.candidates?.[0]?.content?.parts || []; for\(const p of parts\) { if\(p.inlineData\) return {id:i, mimeType:p.inlineData.mimeType, size:p.inlineData.data?.length}; } throw new Error\(''no image''\); }\)\); results.forEach\(\(r,i\) => { if\(r.status===''fulfilled''\) console.log\(''Style'',i,'': OK -'',r.value.mimeType,''size:'',r.value.size\); else console.log\(''Style'',i,'': FAIL -'',r.reason?.message?.substring\(0,100\)\); }\); } t\(\);")
